lead: Moving an item out of a `# Known gaps` block renumbers every item after it, and other files cite those numbers by position.
body: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/db/mod.rs`'s eight became four and twelve citations went stale at once, in six siblings, `queue.rs`, the register and goal `gap-zero`'s two files, because a gap has no name — only a position. Grep `gap [0-9]`, `crate::<module>` and the module's own path across `crates/` and `docs/` *before* the edit, and put the doc and the whole sweep in one `nv splice --patch`.
